fact: On 5 August 2025 the Ethiopian Statistics Service reported capacity-building training in Semera, Afar, for managers and experts from sector offices on collecting, managing and analysing administrative records so that they can be used as official statistics, part of its reform work in the regions.
title: የአስተዳደራዊ መዛግብት መረጃ አሰባሰብ፣ አያያዝና ትንተና ሂደቱን ለማሻሻል የሚያግዝ የግንዛቤ ማስጨበጫ ስልጠና እየተሰጠ ይገኛል
